question: Budget is a record of–

options.text: Monetary Saving policy of the government

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fiscal policy of the government.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The budget is related to the** government's fiscal policy.**
 
• The budget is a **statement of the receipts and expenditure of the government for each financial year.**
 
• It is mentioned in Article 112 </str
